title: Descended open charts with compatible local maps
statement: Let p:X→Y be an fpqc singleton of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], let V→X carry a descent datum D [def-pd-descent-datum], and let U_i be any open covering of V. Let E_i be descent data on U_i→X whose transport maps, after inclusion in V, agree with those of D. Suppose W_i→Y and q_i:U_i→W_i give cartesian squares with p, and q_i is invariant under every transport of E_i. Then there exist W_0→Y and open immersions j_i:W_i→W_0 jointly covering W_0, with j_i over Y, such that on U_i×_V U_k the composites through q_i and j_i and through q_k and j_k agree for all i,k. No global morphism from V is part of the conclusion.

source.place: Descent, Tag 0AP4, construction of the overlaps U_ij and the glued scheme before the final global map

proof.text: For each i,k, take the open preimage of U_k inside U_i. Compatibility of E_i and E_k with D makes this intersection invariant. The cartesian square for q_i and transport invariance identify E_i with the canonical descent datum on the pullback of W_i. Base change makes q_i fpqc. Apply descent of compatible opens to obtain W_ik in W_i pulling back to the intersection.

Restrict the effective data to the intersection and the descended opens. Use the cartesian comparison isomorphisms to express both presentations as canonical pullbacks; transport invariance and the pullback universal property identify the restricted transports with the canonical isomorphisms. The identity between the two presentations of U_i intersect U_k is compatible with these canonical data. The fpqc morphism descent bijection descends it and its inverse to transitions W_ik to W_ki over Y. Injectivity gives inverse identities and the triple cocycle; uniqueness of descended opens gives equality of their triple-overlap domains. This uses singleton fpqc coverage, without assuming that p itself is quasi-compact.

Glue W_i along these open transitions. Scheme.GlueData gives open chart inclusions which jointly cover the glued scheme. Glue the maps to Y, whose restrictions agree because the descended transitions are over Y, obtaining W_0 in Over Y.

On the pullback of U_i and U_k over V, the two projections present the same intersection. Their composites with q_i and q_k factor through W_ik and W_ki, related by the descended transition. Compose the Scheme.GlueData.glue_condition with the intersection projection to obtain equality of the maps into W_0. This asserts overlap agreement without constructing a map V to W_0. Empty I is handled by the empty gluing, while hcover forces V empty.

theorem exists_glued_model_structure
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y}
    (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens)
    (hcover : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι =
        (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι)
          (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left)
    (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q i = a.left ≫ q i) :
    ∃ (W₀ : Over Y) (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left),
      (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
      (∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w) ∧
      (∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom) ∧
      (∀ i k, pullback.fst (U i).ι (U k).ι ≫ q i ≫ j i =
        pullback.snd (U i).ι (U k).ι ≫ q k ≫ j k)
